purpose: Read-only audit of (1) the frozen data split / window arithmetic and (2) the prediction-curve figure semantics, triggered by the suspicion that the report's sentence '训练 717 / 验证 102 / 测试 1025 个窗口' conflates timestamps, sliding-window count, and total rows.

verdict.split_statement_in_report: INCORRECT — '测试 1025 个窗口' is false; 1025 is the TOTAL number of weekly timestamps, not the Test window count
verdict.figure_semantics: CONSISTENT — 'seed-mean lead-1' equals fig_q1 step0; both are rolling-origin lead-1 concatenations
verdict.action: correct the report sentence with machine-extracted counts; figures already semantically correct (no regeneration); regenerate DOCX/PDF; re-QA

paper_pdf.national_illness: 7 variables, United States 2002-2021, includes ages 0-4, number of providers, total national ILI
paper_pdf.lookback_T: 104 steps (prompt: 'Predict the next 24 steps given the previous 104 steps')
paper_pdf.metric_space: MSE and MAE computed after StandardScaler normalization of each input variable (z-space)

configs_py.assert_full_window: refuses any n_rows != 1025 (rejects the 966-row truncated variant)

split_manifest.split_rule: split by target start week; train if <train_end, val if <=val_end else test

raw_csv.note: data/raw/national_illness_raw_paper_exact.csv is 966 rows (200240..202113) and is REJECTED by assert_full_window

split.note: test TIMESTAMP 819 (2018-01-21) is input-context ONLY, never a target; the first target a test window can predict is 820.

window_generation.split_rule: split by target START week ts = origin + T; train if ts < 717, validation if 717 <= ts <= 819, test if ts > 819
window_generation.input_crosses_explanation: the input of a window is data[ts-104 : ts], which for test targets spans the most recent 104 weeks ending at ts-1 (this legitimately includes validation and even the first test timestamp 819 as CONTEXT; the target starts strictly after the input, so there is no leakage).
window_generation.full_future_explanation: a test window's L-step target [ts, ts+L-1] must satisfy ts <= 1025-L so the whole horizon fits in the data; hence test target starts are [820, 1025-L], and the last L-1 test timestamps (1026-L .. 1024) are reached only via step >= 1 of earlier windows, never as a window start.

test_target_weeks.distinct_target_explanation: abs_week [820, 1024]; the full-horizon metric covers all L steps of every test window
test_target_weeks.lead1_explanation: the lead-1 (step 0) prediction curve covers only [820, 1025-L]

do_not_conflate.report_error: the report wrote '训练 717 / 验证 102 / 测试 1025 个窗口': 717 and 102 are timestamp counts, and 1025 is the TOTAL timestamp count mislabeled as Test windows. Correct Test windows are 182/170/158/146 for L=24/36/48/60.

figure_semantics.reference: scripts/q1_step_sweep.py: aggregate_lead_time(mode='fixed_step', step=0) -> keep step 0 (lead-1) rows, groupby(abs_week).mean()
figure_semantics.curve_type: rolling-origin fixed-lead (lead-1) concatenation, NOT single-origin full-L-step forecast
figure_semantics.multiplicity_resolution: at fixed lead each target week has exactly one origin (origin = target_week - 104 - step); the only averaging is across 7 variables (filtered to ILITOTAL index 4) and 10 seeds (seed-mean)

report_fixes_applied.project_summary: already correct (no split-count sentence; caption already says 'seed-mean lead-1') — no change required
